thig13.2:1.1:
Rohiṇī’s father:
You go to sleep saying,
“Contemplatives.”
thig13.2:1.4:
No doubt you will be
a contemplative.
thig13.2:2.4:
Why do you hold
contemplatives dear?
thig13.2:3.1:
They don’t like to work,
they’re lazy,
thig13.2:3.2: living off what’s given by others,
thig13.2:3.3:
full of hankerings,
wanting delicious things:
thig13.2:3.4:
Why do you hold
contemplatives dear?
thig13.2:4.1:
Rohiṇī:
For a long time, father,
thig13.2:5.1:
They do like to work,
they’re not lazy.
thig13.2:5.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:6.1:
They rid themselves
of the three evil roots,
thig13.2:6.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:7.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:8.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:9.3:
they teach the goal
& the Dhamma:
thig13.2:9.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:10.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:11.3:
they discern the end
of suffering:
thig13.2:11.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:12.2:
they don’t turn to look back
at anything.
thig13.2:12.3:
How free from concern
they go!
thig13.2:12.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:13.1: They don’t store in a granary,
thig13.2:13.3:
They hunt [only]
for what’s already cooked:
thig13.2:13.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:14.3: They live off whatever is present:
thig13.2:14.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:15.1:
Having gone forth
from different families
thig13.2:15.3:
still they hold
one another dear:
thig13.2:15.4:
That’s why I hold
contemplatives dear.
thig13.2:16.1:
Rohiṇī’s father:
Rohiṇī, truly for our benefit
thig13.2:16.2: were you born in our family.
thig13.2:16.3:
You have conviction
in the Buddha & Dhamma,
and strong respect
thig13.2:18.3:
Rohiṇī:
If you’re afraid of pain,
thig13.2:19.1: go to the Buddha for refuge,
thig13.2:19.4:
That will lead
to your benefit.
thig13.2:20.1:
Rohiṇī’s father:
I go to the Buddha for refuge;
thig13.2:20.2: I go to the Dhamma & Saṅgha.
thig13.2:20.4:
That will lead
to my benefit.
thig13.2:21.1: Before, I was a kinsman to Brahmā;
